env.description: the environment to deploy to: production, or another's name

name: get_deployment

description: List the apps on this server that this token can see, with the release each is serving.

env.description: the environment, or production if left out

name: list_deployments

env.description: the environment, or production if left out

env.description: the environment, or production if left out

lines.description: how many of the newest lines, up to 1000; 100 if left out

since.description: only since this long ago, such as 10m, or this time
